text:
ivy (PM): Quick spike: customers hit surprise cost spikes when they restore saved views that implicitly change routing (hosted -> dedicated). Need a preflight UX + API flags to make restores explicit.

joel (eng): Agreed. Right now saved_view has model_id and filters; console applies both without verifying routing. We should return `will_change_routing` + `estimated_token_delta` so console can show a confirmation.

mira (platform): Backend can compute routing impact: include `effective_route_type` (hosted|dedicated), `fallback_models` as CSV, and `quota_blocked` boolean. We'll add header `X-SavedView-Preview: v1`.

anya (design): UX: show a compact preflight banner when restore changes route type: "This view will switch routing to Dedicated and may increase cost by ~2.4k tokens per 1k requests. [Switch anyway] [Apply filters only]". Also tiny inline help explaining why routing changed.

lee (sre): Telemetry must capture intent vs effective outcome. Add `saved_view.restore.v1` with fields `requested_model`, `effective_model`, `preview_token_delta`, `user_action` (confirm|filters_only|cancel). Sample at 100% during rollout.

joel (eng): Implementation plan: 1) API returns preview-only fields read-only (2) console surfaces banner but write actions gated by `sv_restore_confirm` flag (3) alert when median `preview_token_delta` > 20% during pilot.

mira (platform): Backcompat: keep old shape, add preview fields optional. We'll include `preview_request_id` to correlate preview -> commit events.

ops-bot: Deploy preview started for platform/sv-preview at 2025-12-08T13:22:10Z

ivy (PM): Action items: mira to land API shim today, anya to post banner copy & microcopy, joel to add flag + client tests, lee to add Grafana panel and pager rule for cost regressions. Sync tomorrow after staging deploy.

joel (eng): One edge-case: if preview shows `quota_blocked=true` we should disable "Switch anyway" and show request quota flow link. Mira can return `quota_contact` to populate that link.

mira (platform): Will include `quota_contact` and `quota_reason` strings. Also `fallback_model_id` if dedicated lacks requested model.

anya (design): For "Apply filters only" we should show a small checkbox "Keep current model" so users can preserve routing. Also add subtle note: "Model pins saved with view remain optional".

lee (sre): I'll add an alert `sv_restore_token_regression` (median delta > 20%) and a dashboard tile: restores by outcome (confirmed/filters_only/cancel) + median delta by org.

ivy (PM): Thank you. Let's keep the preflight strict in pilot; silence surprises.
